_howto: Text for the Phins Playbook pages. Anything marked HANNAH is a placeholder to replace.

principles.title: Be adjustable.
principles.text: Plans break. Adjust and keep going.

principles.title: Never let someone go alone.
principles.text: If a teammate carries, you're there.

principles.title: Stay out of the channel.
principles.text: The sacred channel is the pass from the 9 to the 10. Don't block it.

principles.title: Flexibility over labels.
principles.text: Your number is a starting point, not a cage.

principles.title: Get to the ruck.
principles.text: No matter where you're coming from.

lineoutCalls.how: Jumper and back lifter meet the front lifter. The front lifter does not move.
The front lifter moves back to lift the jumper.
The second person becomes a lifter and turns to lift the jumper.
The second person becomes a lifter and turns to lift the jumper. The pod is farther back.

maulCalls.name: TANGO
points: Do not engage, part the sea.
Only move laterally, you cannot leave the line.

maulCalls.name: SALSA
points: 5 seconds of no forward progress by the opponent = turnover to PHINS!
Do NOT bring it down (i.e. attempt to tackle the ball carrier, be a human speed bump). That is dangerous play resulting in a penalty.

maulCalls.name: Lineout call + M word
points: Recycle if you are not moving, getting pushed back, or turning.
5 seconds of no forward progress by us = turnover to THEM.
Present the ball to the scrum half to prevent that.
